status: Separate exploratory challenger declared before inspecting its public retrieval scores; frozen primary analyzer and policies remain unchanged.
scope: Korean Compound dictionary metadata only; existing core exact lane remains unchanged. Non-Korean tokens use existing core analysis.
expansion: For each Korean stem-lane token, independently obtain a single whole-token Lindera Normal analysis. Expand only dictionary type Compound with at least two well-formed surface/POS/semantic components whose surfaces concatenate exactly to the original normalized token surface. One expansion level only, no recursive guessing, suffix stripping, or hardcoded vocabulary.
offsets: Map normalized component boundaries through original grapheme-cluster NFKC boundaries. Require concatenated cluster normalization to equal the token surface; reject unsafe/interior-cluster boundaries. Preserve original token on every unsupported or unsafe case.
positions: Emit one consecutive flat path of constituents in the stem lane; do not emit the original compound alongside constituents. No synonym graph or position-length equivalence is claimed. The separate precise exact lane retains the original core stream.
prefix: Do not expand the final token when prefix=true.
normalization: Existing core NFKC and locale casing with folding=none only; explicit lossy folding is rejected.
evaluation: Reuse the frozen Korean public query sets, judgments and identical nested 10000/100000 pools, five native retrieval policies from the frozen nine-method study, and development-only acceptance calibration. Publish results separately with challenger fingerprints. No held-out parameter selection.
limitations: One-level compound expansion is not lemmatization, complete Korean morphology, or a general token graph. Cross-grapheme compatibility composition and non-concatenative expressions fall back unchanged. The diagnostic wrapper loads a separate dictionary from the frozen core and does not establish final integrated RAM cost.
origin: Exploratory follow-up motivated by an inspected frozen diagnostic held-out Korean compound miss. It is not an untouched prospective primary comparison; its own public retrieval scores were not inspected before this protocol and implementation.
